A family roadmap page (proposed)

A public roadmap across every repo is designed in docs/roadmap-spec.md, not built. What the prior-art check found, for the next page like it:

  • Open source roadmaps that hold up are built from issues: one public tracking issue per item, a status label, and done closes the issue with a link to what shipped (GitHub's public roadmap, Kubernetes enhancements). Hand-written roadmap pages go stale (the Backstage roadmap names an update date already past).
  • Leave dates out. The roadmaps that give quarters also warn that dates move.
  • Say maturity apart from progress (Kubernetes' alpha, beta, stable). Here that is proven, pre-beta and design, so an item in progress in a design-stage repo can't read as nearly ready.
  • Issue titles are written by whoever opened the issue: a generated page shows only approved items, checks who added the approval label, and pulls an item whose title changed after approval.

These docs are the Markdown in docs/knowledge/; open the folder in Obsidian to browse it as a vault. Each repo is the source of truth for itself.
